name: issue-implementation-planning
description: Route GitHub issue planning to interactive or automatic mode. Use with one or many issue references. Planning only unless execution is explicitly requested.

inputs.name: issue-references
inputs.description: One or more issue numbers or full GitHub issue URLs.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: Optional target repository as owner/name when not inferable.

inputs.name: planning-mode
inputs.description: interactive or automatic; ask which to use when missing.

inputs.name: pr-grouping
inputs.description: Optional override per-issue, related, or single.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers accumulated across clarification loops.

outputs.name: refined-implementation-plan
outputs.description: Final markdown implementation plan after refinement.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of remaining questions after planning.

outputs.name: assumption-log
outputs.description: Labeled assumptions from automatic mode; empty after interactive.
